Loaded Accessibility Review

My role
Accessibility review & annotation
Tools
Figma
Deliverable
Annotated page reconstructions

THE PROJECT

Overview

This academic review uses reconstructed page layouts to identify potential barriers across an e-commerce journey. Lettered annotations connect individual interface elements to a shared review legend.

01 / DESIGN PROCESS

Organize the review into actionable categories

The annotations cover A: color contrast, B: alternative text, C: keyboard focus, D: form labels, and E: heading hierarchy. Grouping findings this way makes the review easier to trace across multiple pages.

02 / DESIGN PROCESS

Follow the task through checkout

The review extends from browsing to a product page and checkout, where controls and form fields become central to completing the task. The annotations highlight questions to investigate in implementation, including whether inputs have accessible labels and interactive elements have a visible focus state.

REFLECTION

What this work shows

The deliverable demonstrates accessibility awareness and a repeatable annotation method. A design file can identify potential issues; verifying contrast, alternative text, keyboard behavior, and semantic structure requires inspection of the implemented website.

Independent academic review of loaded.com, not commissioned client work or a certification of the live site. Original file: loaded accessibility audit.fig.
